```plato
    // The IDeformable3D obligation: every boundary vertex carried through the
    // mapping. The declaration's planarity invariant survives affine mappings
    // only; a nonlinear mapping leaves a ring the planar bodies above treat as
    // its best-fit-plane projection (the same control-point decay as
    // `brep.library.plato`).
    Deform(p: Polygon3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): Polygon3D
        => Polygon3D(p.Points.Map(mapping));
```

## Line 453

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 453](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L453).

```plato

    // The IDeformable3D obligation: the base ring and the Apex carried through
    // the same mapping — the cone over the deformed base from the deformed apex.
    Deform(y: Pyramid3D, mapping: Function1<Point3D, Point3D>): Pyramid3D
        => (y.Base.Deform(mapping), mapping(y.Apex));
```
